evidence.detail: card search checks `'err' in card_data` but dreadrise_search_json returns {'success': False, 'reason': '...'} on error — no 'err' key, so the error is silently swallowed
dreadrise_search_json catches FetchException/JSONDecodeError/InvalidDataException and returns {'success': False, 'reason': 'The request failed.'} — no 'err' key
deck search correctly checks `if not data['success']` — card search should use the same pattern

triage.fix_sketch: In discordbot/commands/dreadrise.py line 26, change `if 'err' in card_data and card_data['err']:` to `if not card_data.get('success', True):` and update line 27 to use `card_data.get('reason', 'Unknown error')`. This makes the card search error handling consistent with deck/matchup search.
triage.notes: The same inconsistency means if the second dreadrise_search_cards call (line 33) also errors, it will KeyError on 'sample'. The fix should also guard that call.
